# Set up environment and load and prepare data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# Load libraries
library(prabclus)
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(ape)
library(phytools)

# Load gene presence/absence  data
gene_pres_abs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/gene_presence_absence.csv")

# List samples from each dataset
NL_metadata <- read.xlsx("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/0.Raw_data/Netherlands_Sanger_metadata.xlsx", 1) 
NLD_samples <- NL_metadata |> filter(ENA.lane.accession %in% colnames(gene_pres_abs)) |> pull(ENA.lane.accession)
CDC_metadata <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Typing/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/phenotypes.txt", header=T) 
CDC_samples <- CDC_metadata |> filter(samples %in% colnames(gene_pres_abs)) |> pull(samples)

# Load metadata
phenotypes <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/phenotypes_filtered.txt", header=T)|>
  rename(Sample =samples ) |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(binary==0, "EOD", "LOD/VLOD"))
SCs <- read.csv("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/GBS_GWAS_db_core_clusters.csv") |> rename(Sample=Taxon, SC=Cluster)
metadata <- left_join(SCs, phenotypes) |> 
  mutate(Country= ifelse(Sample %in% NLD_samples, "NL", 
                         ifelse(Sample %in% CDC_samples, "USA", "TW")) )|> 
  filter(Country != "TW")

# Import tree
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW")
Fasttree <- read.tree("FastTree_phylo.tre")
Fasttree_mid <- midpoint.root(Fasttree)
Fasttree_mid_clean <- keep.tip(Fasttree_mid, metadata |> filter(Sample %in% Fasttree_mid$tip.label) |> pull(Sample))

# Cophenetic Distances
cophenetic_matrix <- cophenetic(Fasttree_mid_clean)
cophenetic_melt <- melt(cophenetic_matrix)|> rename(cophenetic=value)

# Reformat gene presence/absence data
gene_pres_abs_clean <- gene_pres_abs |>  
  dplyr::select(contains(c(NLD_samples, CDC_samples))) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(c(NLD_samples, CDC_samples)), ~ ifelse(. == "", 0, 1)))

# Accessory genome distances (jaccard dissimilarity)
jacc_dist <- jaccard(as.matrix(gene_pres_abs_clean))
jacc_dist_melt <- melt(jacc_dist)|> rename(jacc_dist=value)

# Join Cophenetic and Accessory distances
dist_df <- ((left_join(cophenetic_melt, jacc_dist_melt)) |> 
  filter(Var1 != Var2)|>
  mutate(Sorted_Vars = paste(pmin(as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)), 
                             pmax(as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)), sep = "_"))|>
  arrange(Sorted_Vars)|> 
    dplyr::select(-Sorted_Vars))

df_unique <- dist_df %>%
  mutate(pair_id = paste(pmin(as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
                         pmax(as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)), sep = "_")) %>%
  distinct(pair_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(-pair_id)

df_unique
```


# 1. Plot core vs accessory distances
```{r}
# Reformat data 
dist_df1 <- left_join(df_unique |> rename(Sample= Var1), 
                      metadata |> dplyr::select(Sample, SC))|> 
  rename(Sample1=Sample, SC1=SC)
dist_df2 <- left_join(dist_df1 |> rename(Sample= Var2),  
                      metadata |> dplyr::select(Sample, SC))|> 
  rename(Sample2=Sample, SC2=SC)
dist_df3 <- dist_df2 |> 
  mutate(SC_binary = ifelse(SC1==SC2, "Same", "Different"), 
         SC_cat = ifelse(SC_binary=="Different", "Different", SC1))

# Test Correlation between core and accessory distances
cor_test<- cor.test(dist_df3$cophenetic, dist_df3$jacc_dist)

# PLOT
library(cartography)
my_colors <- carto.pal("pastel.pal", n1=2)
corr_all <- dist_df3 |>
  ggplot(aes(x=cophenetic, y= jacc_dist, col=SC_binary))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5)+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Core Distance (Cophenetic distances)")+
  ylab("Accessory Distance (Jaccard Dissimilarity)")+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+
  labs(color="Sequence Cluster")+
  scale_color_manual(name="Sequence Cluster", values = my_colors) +
  annotate(geom="text", x=0.001, y=0.3, label=paste("R =",round(cor_test$estimate,3))) +
  annotate(geom="text", x=0.005, y=0.28, label="p < 0.001")

corr_all

# save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/3.Accessory_core_corr_All.png", plot = corr_all, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```


# 2. Plot Core vs Accessory distance by SC (only among the most common)
```{r}
SC_colors <- c("#dbdb8d", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd", 
                   "#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf",
                   "#f7b6d2", "#c5b0d5", "#c49c94")
names(SC_colors) <- as.character(1:14)

corr_by_SC <- dist_df3 |>
  filter(SC_binary =="Same", SC_cat %in% names(SC_colors))|> 
  mutate(SC_cat=factor(SC_cat, levels=names(SC_colors)))|> 
  arrange(SC_cat)|>
  ggplot(aes(x=cophenetic, y= jacc_dist, col=SC_cat))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.7)+
  facet_grid(~ SC_cat, scales="free_x")+
  theme_classic()+
  xlab("Core Distance (Cophenetic Distance)")+
  ylab("Accessory Distance (Jaccard Dissimilarity)")+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+
  labs(color="Sequence Cluster")+
  scale_color_manual(name="Sequence Cluster", values = SC_colors) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust=0.5))

corr_by_SC

# save
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pangenome_analysis/3.Accessory_core_corr_by_SC.png", plot = corr_by_SC, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")
```
